title: Indian Ocean Tsunami
description:
On December 26, 2004, a massive undersea earthquake off the coast of **Sumatra, Indonesia**, triggered a devastating tsunami.

The earthquake, magnitude 9.1-9.3, was the third-largest ever recorded. The resulting tsunami waves reached heights of up to 30 meters (100 feet).

The disaster killed approximately 230,000 people across 14 countries, making it one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.
